blocks.text: lā nāqata lī fīhā wa-lā jamal

content: A proverb old enough to be classical and still in daily use. English reaches for a horse it has not got. Arabic is more thorough, and rules out the herd one sex at a time.
Greek  ·  Spanish  ·  French  ·  Hungarian  ·  Dutch  ·  Estonian  ·  Latvian  ·  Hebrew  ·  Russian  ·  Ukrainian
You mention someone, and in they walk. It happens in every country.
Every country has also decided who it is that comes when called, and it is a fair guide to what that country thinks of visitors.
